definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 (4.23) defines boolean position only as storage ('The amount of physical storage required to store, or presentation space required to print or display, a single boolean character'); 2023 adds the location sense (3.25). In GR1 ('Leftmost-position represents a boolean position, alphanumeric position, or national position') the unit counted is the same in both, so the boolean items reached and the position arithmetic are unchanged.
